answer: One concrete defense is a first-loss subordination tranche: every new identity enters a junior layer that absorbs 100% of any network fraud loss before a single established senior agent is touched, and it must clear a long probation of peer-confirmed honest work before promotion. An operator minting a thousand sybils just pours its own stake into this first-loss river, where ordinary network fraud drains the fakes to bedrock long before any climb the mesa to senior standing. Honest nodes above only watch the junior swarm's capital spiral away into losses they themselves never feel.
